description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for browsing projects within the Coocook application. It includes a method 'index' that handles HTTP GET and HEAD requests to list projects, optionally including user-specific projects, and prepares data for rendering.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Browse::Project
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for browsing projects, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET and HEAD requests to list projects, including public and user-specific projects, and sets up project URLs for display.
